name: How long does it take to build a multigenerational living suite?
description: Building a suite can take 6 to 18 months, depending on construction type, size, and local permitting timelines.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a multigenerational living suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building a multigenerational living suite depends on whether it's a conversion or new construction, the size, and the complexity of the design. Typically, the entire process, including design, permitting, and construction, can range from 6 to 18 months. Permitting can be a significant variable, so understanding the local review timelines in cities like Fremont or San Leandro is essential when planning your project.
